title: Medical office backflow testing: confirm access, records, and closeout
description: Medical-office testing requires controlled access, a known asset record, low-disruption scheduling, clear repair escalation, and documented filing.
prompt: How should a medical office protect patient operations while completing testing?
answer: Medical-office testing requires controlled access, a known asset record, low-disruption scheduling, clear repair escalation, and documented filing. The right workflow protects both the backflow obligation and patient operations.
urgency: Escalate any work that affects critical water use, infection-control practices, unknown connections, or a repair needing shutdown.
diagramAlt: Backflow service and compliance workflow reference
